candidates.B1(a): Model A v2 code-only risk score (V3)
candidates.B2: Provenance-only LR [role one-hot, ai_involvement, temperature] (edit_distance_ratio and churn dropped as constant in real provenance)
candidates.B3: Static-only LR [flawfinder and cppcheck family findings]
candidates.B4: Model B v2 Offset Fusion: logit(P_risk) = logit(P_code) + w * prov + b
candidates.B4s: Model B v2 Offset Fusion with static: logit(P_risk) = logit(P_code) + w * prov + v * static + b
candidates.B5: Control model: B4 with provenance features permuted/shuffled within task

evaluation_protocol.decision_threshold: Tuned inside train folds to maximize balanced accuracy
hypotheses_paired_tests: B4 vs B1(a) (provenance improves code risk)
B4 vs B5 (provenance signal is non-random)
B4s vs B3 (code+provenance beats static alone)
B1(b) vs B1(a) (Juliet model beats real-world Model A)
evaluation_protocol.correction: Holm step-down across the 4 paired comparisons
evaluation_protocol.selection_rule: Highest AUROC among models not significantly worse than next simpler; if provenance adds nothing, Model B = Model A + static fusion
